name: Heart of the Sun
source:
Two siblings must make life-changing decisions in deeply authoritarian 1960 South Korea. Their paranoid father is a policeman, acting as the long arm of the law. What paths will they take, and why does the Sun burn in Young-ho's chest?

[From [url=https://coco-adventurer.itch.io/heart-of-the-sun]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
1960年的韩国，两个兄弟姐妹必须做出改变生活的决定。他们偏执的父亲是一名警察，充当法律的长臂。他们将采取什么道路，为什么太阳在英浩的胸口燃烧？

[来自[url=https://coco-adventurer.itch.io/heart-of-the-sun]itch.io[/url]]
